purpose: Capture substantive publications and program information surfaced while resolving the unverified 79305-MHz claim, with explicit Worldshepherd routing and negative-control boundaries.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or a negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, derivative copies, and repeated records are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Search co-occurrence or a numeric collision is not Glob evidence and receives zero evidence weight unless independently verified as a physical or relational feature.

sources.title: Design and testing of a high power, ultra-high vacuum, dual-directional coupler for the Advanced Photon Source (APS) linear accelerator
sources.authors: S. O. Brauer; A. E. Grelick; J. Grimmer; R. D. Otocki; Y. W. Kang; J. Noonan; T. Russell
sources.authority: Argonne National Laboratory / IEEE Particle Accelerator Conference
sources.note: Use the WR-284 high-power directional-coupler redesign as a practical RF hardware reference for forward/reverse power sensing, directivity, coupling calibration, vacuum-window maintainability, geometric tolerance sensitivity, and network-analyzer verification. The -79.305 dB table entry that caused search retrieval is an incidental numeric collision and carries zero Glob evidence weight.

sources.title: LHD experimental program completion and continuing data-research notice
sources.note: NIFS states that LHD experiments concluded on 2025-12-25 after more than 27 years and more than 200,000 ultra-high-temperature plasma discharges, while emphasizing continuing discovery from the accumulated data. Use this to prioritize the LHD repository as a mature retrospective validation corpus rather than as a live-shot experimental feed.

search_noise_disposition.rule: Nontechnical retail, financial-instrument, legal-number, social-post, page-number, ranking-percentage, address, and similar 79.305/79305 collisions surfaced while resolving the Yb claim are N0 controls unless they independently contain reusable engineering/scientific content.
search_noise_disposition.note: Do not create independent evidence records for duplicate mirrors or pure navigation/search noise; preserve them only as collision-class exemplars when needed for false-positive testing.

claim_update.basis: The 2019 Yb microwave publication is verified and useful, but this pass did not locate an authoritative primary-table or primary-figure occurrence of exact 79305 MHz/79.305 GHz.
claim_update.worldshepherd_action: Keep the Yb paper in the knowledge base for spectroscopy and polarizability methodology; keep the exact-number P1 claim gated until directly verified.
